question: To reach point B from point A, Anita must walk 70 m towards the west, then she must take a right turn and walk 70 m, then she must take a left turn and walk 150 m, then she must take a left turn and walk 70 m, then she must take a left turn and walk 90 m, then she must take a right turn and walk 100 m, and finally she must take a left turn and walk 130 m. How far and in which direction is point B from point A ? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: 

To reach point B from point A, Anita must walk 70 m towards the west,

then she must take a right turn and walk 70 m,

then she must take a left turn and walk 150 m,

then she must take a left turn and walk 70 m,

then she must take a left turn and walk 90 m,

then she must take a right turn and walk 100 m,

and finally she must take a left turn and walk 130 m. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dbd1f30f67c6c8c4340ed685931a5bf58ac8903eb918962acb76eb8c679bbcb.png] 

So, point B is 100 m in the South from point A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
